claim_boundary: This is a post-heldout diagnostic designed after seeing the NULL failure. It may identify a useful minimal next model class, but it is not confirmatory model selection and cannot change the frozen v1 scalar-target winner or establish a causal environmental process.
stop_rule: Run the five-family 24-draw diagnostic once and freeze it. Do not change candidate membership, adequacy thresholds, seed count, permutation count, or minimality ordering because of the outcome. Any further mechanism refinement is a new version.
